summary: Voyager Technologies filed an 8-K reporting issuance of $402.5 million aggregate principal of 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2032 under an indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee; the $52.5 million initial-purchaser option was fully exercised. Notes are senior unsecured obligations, non-interest-bearing, maturing October 15, 2032, convertible only on specified events before July 15, 2032 and freely thereafter, with up to 0.50% special interest for filing or legend-removal failures. This is a routine convertible financing, not a special situation; watch conversion-price terms and any hedging overhang in the omitted exhibits.
